records.eligibility_summary: Competitive merit- and need-based scholarships the College of Engineering awards to incoming students in its degree programs, from a holistic review of admitted-student materials; renewable up to three additional years. No amount is printed.
records.major_requirement: In addition to Oregon State University financial aid and scholarship programs, the College of Engineering awards hundreds of scholarships to support undergraduate students in the college’s degree programs. … The College of Engineering awards highly competitive, merit and need based scholarships to incoming students. The awards are based on a holistic review of admitted student application materials, and are eligible for renewal up to three additional years. By submitting the application for admission to OSU, incoming freshmen are automatically considered for these scholarships.
